summary.text: Derek Stanford has been a member of the Washington State Senate since 2019, according to his official biography. He serves as Vice Chair of the Ways & Means Committee and sits on the Business, Trade & Economic Development and Labor & Commerce committees.

paragraphs.text: Stanford holds a PhD in Statistics from the University of Washington, an MS in Mathematics from Claremont Graduate University and a BS in Mathematics from Harvey Mudd College, according to his official biography.
Outside the Senate, the page says he works at Boeing leading projects in software development and analytics.

It says he previously served as director of analytics at companies specializing in fraud detection and customer insights, ran a small consulting business in applied statistics and data science, and was principal investigator on a research project for DARPA.
The page says Stanford served in the Washington House of Representatives from 2011 to 2019, where he chaired the House Commerce & Gaming Committee.

It also lists past membership on the Community Economic Redevelopment Board, the Legislative Evaluation and Accountability Program Committee and the Joint Legislative Audit and Review Committee, and current service on the Caseload Forecast Council and the Technology Services Board.
